title: Pestmatic Smart Moth Trap, 8 Clothes Moth Monitoring Traps for Wardrobe, 6+2 Anti Moth Pheromone Trap + Power-Up lighting Plates, Sticky Traps, Alternative for Moth Killer and Moth Repellent
bullet_points: ✅ SMART & EFFECTIVE- innovative power-up sticky moth traps with additional day lighting plates specialise in the intensive capture of clothes moths. The attractant is a female pheromone luring males into the trap, preventing the formation of new generations of clothes moths.

✅ INNOVATIVE MOTH TRAP- Our wool moth catcher not only includes a fragrance-free pheromone but also 2 photoluminescent plates that emit ARTIFICIAL yellow light in the dark, which effectively attracts clothes moths. They will fly around the YELLOW light, but it's the sticky pheromone on the trap that catches them.

✅ UNIQUE DESIGN- the house moth trap's unique design makes it easier and more enticing for the insects to enter the glued surface. The insect monitoring trap is easy and quick to assemble. Our trap has been carefully designed and improved over the years. Each of our moth traps have an optional hook if you want to hang them in your wardrobe, and are also designed to be placed flat.

✅ ECO FRIENDLY & BIODEGRADABLE- Our main goal these days is to live in harmony with our environment, therefore our pheromone traps are made 100% out of kraft paper with biodegradable cover dividers. The traps are odourless, recyclable and harmless to humans and pets.

✅ PREMIUM QUALITY PRODUCED IN EUROPE- unlike other moth traps on the market that are made in China, the SMART Trap has been produced in the UK and created based on many years of experience designing the most powerful traps. The high-quality materials used ensure durability, reliability, effectiveness, and practicality against clothes, wardrobe and carpet moths. Our pheromone traps will deal with clothes moths for you!
